WM5EAM.desc.name: Add mastery link to weapon descriptions
WM5EAM.desc.hint: Appends a link to the mastery's rule page at the end of each weapon's description.
WM5EAM.infer.name: Fill missing base items from weapon name
WM5EAM.infer.hint: When a Simple or Martial weapon has no base item, match it by name (e.g. 'Spiked Bone Club' becomes Club).
WM5EAM.grant.name: Grant player characters their weapon masteries
WM5EAM.grant.hint: Adds each owned weapon's base item to the character's mastery list. Ignores class limits on how many weapon kinds can be mastered.
WM5EAM.autoTrigger.name: Automatically trigger masteries for
WM5EAM.autoTrigger.hint: Sets Automated Masteries 5e's auto-trigger for every user at login. 'Everyone on' or 'Everyone off' hides the per-player checkbox. 'Each player chooses' restores it.
